kanhe.screen.title: Server Password
kanhe.screen.help: Type the password from the server admin. Leave it empty if the server has no password.
disconnect.kanhe.wrong: Wrong server password - ask the admin for the current password
commands.kanhe.length: Random password length is now %s, new password: %s
commands.kanhe.mode: Random password mode is now '%s', new password: %s
commands.kanhe.mode.invalid: Unknown mode '%s' - use digits, lowercase letters or mixed
commands.kanhe.invalid: The password must be 1 to %s visible characters (no spaces)
commands.kanhe.help.title: Kanhe - join password commands:
commands.kanhe.help.show: /kanhe show - show the current password, random mode, random length and state
commands.kanhe.help.reset: /kanhe reset - generate a new random password using the current mode and length
commands.kanhe.help.set: /kanhe set <password> - set a password manually (does not change mode or length)
commands.kanhe.help.length: /kanhe length <4-32> - change the random password length and generate a new one
commands.kanhe.help.mode: /kanhe mode <mode> - change the random password mode (digits / letters / mixed) and generate a new one
commands.kanhe.help.toggle: /kanhe on | off - enable or disable the protection
